verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented API endpoint for retrieving marketing campaign or automation-flow performance metrics. The closest items are adjacent: a raw export of transactional email events from the past 7 days, revenue attribution to campaigns within the ecommerce feature, and customer-data sync with warehouses. None of these shows a developer pulling campaign or flow performance stats through the API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull campaign and flow performance metrics through the API into my own warehouse or dashboards
